Local impact: sourceAccuracy, readerUsability and quality are preserved for accepted COM002/003/004/005/006/007/009/012 and existing accepted OPL scopes. The communication rewrites preserve meaning. The generated Secret descriptions match the owning generator, runtime allowlist, controller copy operation and separately applied workload manifest. No new whole OPL acceptance is granted.

Whole A912-01: NOT_READY. SourceAccuracy PASS for the inspected positive selection and staging contracts; readerUsability and quality NOT_READY for whole-gate acceptance. The explicit classification drives the positive manifest, the checker compares its generated contents, and unexpected Markdown fails selection. However, the negative injection tests assert selector/manifest rejection without exercising the actual publication build or proving absence from rendered routes and output. The build copies Markdown and assets into staging; its manifest hash does not establish a complete rendered HTML publication. The supplied logs show 14 passing tests and a successful 167-page staging build; the check log retains the earlier failure, so the reported later terminal PASS is not independently recorded there. Reader prose also retains documentation-work commentary at docs/site/decisions/runtime-and-operations.md:112 ('This product rule does not request new documentation branches'). Legitimate product review, migration and audit terminology is not itself a defect.

These whole-gate deficiencies predate the two-file diff and are not patch findings. Read-only inspection only; no tests, product/live commands, edits or nested reviewers. Unrelated ready-topics reports were excluded. No broader acceptance is granted.
